name: Mapa de Frecuencia del Fondo
description: Maps frecuencia content of background regions
algorithm: Background Frequency Map — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method creates frequency maps of video backgrounds for forensic deepfake detection:

1. **Background Segmentation**: Face/body regions are segmented and separated from the background using semantic segmentation. The background region is isolated for independent frequency analysis, avoiding frequency interference from the dynamically changing foreground.

2. **Espacial Frecuencia Mapeo**: 2D FFT is computed over background regions in each frame, creating a spatial frequency map. Natural backgrounds exhibit stable frequency content dominated by scene-specific features (texture of walls, furniture patterns, foliage). The frequency map reveals the spectral signature of the background.

3. **Temporal Frecuencia Estabilidad**: Background frequency maps across frames are compared. In authentic video with a stationary camera, background frequencies remain nearly constant. Deepfake generators may introduce frame-to-frame frequency artifacts in the background — subtle spectral flickering from imperfect temporal consistency in the generation process.

4. **Cross - Región Frecuencia Consistencia**: Different background regions should show frequency characteristics consistent with a single imaging pipeline. GAN or diffusion-generated backgrounds may show frequency inconsistencies between spatial regions — different noise patterns, compression artifacts, or spectral energy distributions in different parts of the generated background.

5. **Frecuencia Anomalía Puntuación**: The temporal variance of background frequency maps, cross-region frequency consistency, and deviation from expected spectral profiles are combined into a forensic score. Elevated scores indicate backgrounds that exhibit frequency characteristics inconsistent with natural video capture.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: frecuencia
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated video through background frecuencia map analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for video authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
